name: v195_sales_option_largecap_gate
hypothesis: akdGGj9w missed the sub-universe Sharpe check by only 0.01. A stricter large-cap gate may remove unstable small-cap names while preserving sales delivery plus short-option confirmation.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.58, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Minimal LSUS repair for akdGGj9w; reject if corr to A1wLWmwY/P0pYj5Px is high.

name: v195_sales_option_subindustry_rank
hypothesis: Moving the sales-delivery and option-risk sleeves to subindustry ranking may improve cross-subuniverse stability without adding crowded EPS/value or quality legs.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), subindustry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), subindustry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), subindustry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Targets LSUS with local peer ranking rather than new factors.

name: v195_sales_option_subindustry_neut

expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.34 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Same expression as akdGGj9w with tighter neutralization.

name: v195_sales_option_lower_option_weight
hypothesis: LSUS failure may come from the option sleeves. Lowering short-option exposure and emphasizing sales delivery plus risk relief may pass sub-universe while staying below correlation limits.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.16 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry) + 0.10 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: If this passes LSUS but maps to A1wLWmwY, do not submit.

name: v195_sales_option_no_corr_leg

expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.45, 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(actual_sales_value_quarterly / sales_estimate_average_quarterly, 126), industry) + 0.24 * group_rank(ts_rank((call_breakeven_60 - put_breakeven_60) / close, 60), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (implied_volatility_mean_60 - historical_volatility_60), 60), industry) + 0.16 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 60), industry), -1)
notes: No correlation_last_90_days_spy leg; tests if the stabilizer caused LSUS fragility.

name: v195_sales_option_low_turnover
